name: revayat-subtitle
description: Translate and edit anime subtitles with cue review and FFmpeg visual checks. Persian is the default; the project bundles Persian, Russian and English voice guides.

interface.longDescription: Review every cue, reconcile competing releases, preserve Japanese honorifics and names, inspect FFmpeg renders and deliver Sub.zip.
defaultPrompt: Translate these subtitles into spoken Persian.
Repair this Persian season and give me Sub.zip.
